<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 121.0528, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 120.0455 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₄H₈O₄ (monoisotopic mass 120.0423 Da), within typical experimental error. No other heteroatoms are indicated by the spectrum. Therefore the molecular formula is C4H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
